excerpt: AI-native OS for insurance brokers Covera builds AI agents for insurance brokers. Our ready-to-use agents take over the day-to-day servicing work: submission intake, carrier quoting, quote comparison, claims handling, past-due collections, and account rounding. That means brokers can spend their time advising and selling clients instead of doing data entry. We work with agencies of every size and connect natively to the tools they already use. Reported team size: 2. YC marks the company as hiring.
